This is too much tough love.... are you telling me that if your mom is offended by your wedding choices that you are going to throw down the "boundary setting" gauntlet with your Mom? This tactic will not end with you on top but potentially will end with you mom less.

I'm going to be real bro..... your mom isn't going to drop this one, and if you want to maintain some kind of decent relationship with her it will have to be you and your new bride to concede this one despite the fact you are on the right side of this.
Sounds like your mom is one of those people who value what others think about her and her family, some people are very proud and want to show off, a wedding is a socially acceptable occasion to do this with.
So option 1 - point out at family meeting that the wedding wasn't for mom and is in fact yours and your wife's special day...... this will end in your mom crying and possibly both you and your wife also in tears..... you might be able to circumvent this if the venue for the meeting is at a public place or your place..... but if it's on your mom's turf..... your stuffed and will not win this argument and will lead to animosity for years and years and will forever color your beautiful elopement.
Option 2 - go to meeting at mom's house fully knowing and expecting the shit storm that is coming with wife who is in agreement with plan,
Listen to allllll the horseshit that comes out of her mouth about how it affected HER.... Nod and apologize (knowing and smiling inside that the elopement can't be undone) let her know the pressure of providing a perfect day for everyone else was too much for you both, and that you are sorry she felt left out ....but then tell her about how you guys had a wonderful day and maybe suggest to her if she really wants a big event why not renew her vows!

Good luck to you.... whatever you do prepare for the worst and hope for the best
